symbols.name: transform length
symbols.meaning: The number of entries in the input and output vectors, a count of entries.
symbols.quote: Let $q$ be the number of entries in the vector.

symbols.name: root of unity
symbols.meaning: A primitive q-th root of unity, a complex number whose powers are all distinct and whose q-th power is 1.
symbols.quote: Let $\omega$ be a primitive $q$-th root of unity.

symbols.name: input vector
symbols.meaning: The input list of q complex numbers, written a = (a_0, ..., a_{q-1}).
symbols.quote: Let $a = (a_0, a_1, \dots, a_{q-1})$ be the input vector.

symbols.name: input position
symbols.meaning: The index running over the input positions 0 to q-1.
symbols.quote: Index $j$ runs over the input positions, so $a_j$ is the entry at position $j$.

symbols.name: transformed vector
symbols.meaning: The output list of q complex numbers, the transform of a.
symbols.quote: The transform $\hat a = (\hat a_0, \dots, \hat a_{q-1})$ of $a$ has $q$ entries.

symbols.name: output position
symbols.meaning: The index running over the output positions 0 to q-1; on this page it replaces the padded width k of earlier pages.
symbols.quote: Index $k$ runs over the output positions, so $\hat a_k$ is the output at position $k$; here $k$ no longer denotes the padded width of earlier pages.
